name: MarineVerse for Teams
summary:
Bring sailing to your school, club, event or organisation with MarineVerse for Teams.

MarineVerse for Teams is the team and event edition of MarineVerse Sailing Club, designed for group use in educational, training and public event settings. It makes it easy to introduce people to sailing, run guided sessions, and create memorable shared experiences in VR.
